reason: Answer from Priya Shah (MLRO) to q_01: high-risk approval is by the MLRO; Engagement Partner is informed.

value.title: SME answer q_01 – Priya Shah (MLRO), 1 Oct 2026

ops.value: The MLRO approves the engagement for a high-risk client before it proceeds; the Engagement Partner is informed of the decision. The Engagement Partner should escalate promptly if they have concerns.

value.notes: Approver changed from Engagement Partner to MLRO per July 2026 policy change (SOP v4 §4.2 outdated).

provenance.excerpt: High-risk clients must be approved by the Engagement Partner before the engagement can proceed
high-risk approval is done by me as MLRO, not the engagement partner
Correct – since July high-risk approval is by me as MLRO. The Engagement Partner is informed of the decision but doesn't approve.

ops.value: the Engagement Partner is informed of the MLRO's decision
